sloka: कामं मध्ये समुद्रस्य लङ्केयं दुष्प्रधर्षणा ।न तु राघवबाणानां गतिरोधीह विद्यते ।। ५.२६.१७।।।।
transliteration: kāmaṁ madhye samudrasya laṅkeyaṁ duṣpradharṣaṇā ।na tu rāghavabāṇānāṁ gatirodhīha vidyate ।। 5.26.17।।।।

translations.english: "This Lanka in the middle of the ocean is unassailable. But there is nothing which can resist the arrows of Rama.
